name: hide-pin-button-for-twitch-addon
description: Firefox extension that hides the pin button in Twitch chat for moderators (English & German)

scripts.start: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir . --start-url https://www.twitch.tv
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir . --overwrite-dest --ignore-files src tsconfig.json package*.json node_modules .idea
